voice._notes: Neural voice via edge-tts (English/Telugu/Hindi), auto language-detected. language: auto|en|te|hi. Install with 'install the autonomous toolkit'. stt_langs are tried in order for speech recognition.

gemini._notes: Google Gemini via its OpenAI-compatible endpoint. Change 'model' to any you have access to, e.g. gemini-3.5-flash, gemini-2.5-pro, gemini-2.5-flash-lite. Key from https://aistudio.google.com/apikey -> paste into .env as GEMINI_API_KEY.

llm._notes: Default brain is 'claude' (fast cloud). Switch live with 'use claude' / 'use perplexity' / 'use nvidia' / 'use ollama'. Cloud keys read from .env, never stored here.
llm._smart_route_notes: When true, JARVIS auto-picks the best brain PER REQUEST: research/live-web -> perplexity, hard reasoning/code -> claude, quick/cheap -> gemini/nvidia, private/offline -> ollama. Falls through the usual fallback chain if the picked brain is down. 'use <brain>' still pins a brain manually.

companion._notes: Set commute_to (e.g. 'Office, 123 Main St') so the 1pm midday check can open live Google Maps traffic for your route. Leave blank to get weather only. commute_from is optional; blank = current location.

vision._notes: Screen vision (Claude eyes). 'see/look at my screen', 'verify <X> on screen'. Needs ANTHROPIC_API_KEY + pillow.

proactive._notes: Background monitoring. JARVIS checks your watches every interval and surfaces alerts. Read-only.

autonomy._notes: JARVIS may think/act a little independently within the master's standing instructions and Tier-1 actions; it asks permission for anything novel, out-of-scope, or risky, and never overrides the master.

proactive_advice._notes: Iron-Man-style unprompted advice. JARVIS watches your current browser tab and volunteers ONE useful suggestion at most every min_gap_seconds, only when the page changed and it has something genuinely worth saying (else stays silent). Needs the controlled browser (start_my_chrome.bat) to see your tab. Say 'proactive off' to silence. Surfaces via the HUD/voice alert buffer.

iron_man._notes: Iron Man Mode = continuous self-driving autonomy. Say 'iron man mode on' to engage. It works queued goals ('add goal <x>') one at a time through the safe MissionControl loop, pausing for 'confirm' on anything irreversible. interval_seconds = how often it checks for work; max_missions_per_day + mission_budget bound runaway cost; improve_every_missions = how often it self-reviews + proposes next goals when idle.

remote._notes: Phase 4 LAN-only remote control (e.g. your phone). DISABLED by default. To use: set JARVIS_REMOTE_TOKEN in .env, set enabled=true, then POST {"text":"..."} to http://<pc-lan-ip>:8765/command with header 'Authorization: Bearer <token>'. Refuses to start without the token. Keep it behind your router — never port-forward to the internet. Class B actions (delete, shutdown, install, trades) still require a separate 'confirm' command even remotely.
